status: proposed specifications, no runtime acceptance performed

requirements.requirement: Every advertised profile MUST name its exact feature set and qualification tuple.
Missing native prerequisites MUST leave dependent actions unavailable without ordinary-agent fallback.
P2 MUST produce a useful local project artifact through mediated operations.
Installation and enrollment MUST preserve existing agent profiles and unrelated desktop configuration.
Completion claims MUST distinguish verified effects, observed tests, model explanations and uncertainty.
Recovery MUST retain original task, authority and native operation bindings.
Expansion decisions MUST record measured adoption results and explicit stopping-rule outcomes.
The product MUST disclose the default desktop-trust boundary and unsupported profiles during enrollment.
First launch exposes only qualified profiles and distinguishes read-only readiness from execution readiness.
Project import binds resolved identity and preserves unrelated source-tree work.
Task start is deliberate, canonically bound and idempotent under lost responses.
Task state and connectivity remain distinct and mutations require fresh state.
Overview/detail remain responsive with bounded activity and no focus stealing.
Review distinguishes native outcome, artifact checks, publication and verified receipts.
Exact native approval is unavailable until qualified and rejects changed, expired or stale bindings.
Cancellation reports in-flight uncertainty and never implies rollback.
Unknown outcomes reconcile the same operation without blind retries.
Every journey is operable by keyboard with correct editor and multi-monitor focus behavior.
Controls, states, scaling, contrast and motion meet the stated accessibility contract.
Lock/unknown-lock states conceal sensitive content and refuse mutations until freshly reconciled.
Notifications are private, rate-limited navigation with no authority effects.
Credentials and provider budget claims reflect qualified native behavior.
Upgrade and reconnect invalidate stale decisions without duplicating work.
Disable/uninstall distinguish client removal, task handling and explicit data deletion.
Chio preserves upstream Agents/default-agent and existing menu/shortcut settings.
Untrusted content cannot alter navigation, commands or exact review presentation.
The manifest and package conform to the supported schema without invented security or activation guarantees.
Late injection, multiple monitors and repeated readiness produce exactly one shared service connection.
Open/close/summon payloads perform only bounded validated navigation.
QML communicates through the pinned literal-argv shim with stdin JSON and no credential inheritance.
Streams, queues, models and rendering obey the stated resource bounds.
Epoch/sequence snapshot resynchronization prevents stale or missing transitions being presented as current.
Mutations bind exact native identity, canonical arguments, idempotency and current revision.
Client destruction/reload never cancels, duplicates or supervises native tasks.
Protocol/profile incompatibility fails closed with useful read-only diagnostics.
The supported bar contract is explicit and replacement-bar degradation never bypasses facade boundaries.
Cache and lock handling prevent sensitive persistent UI state and stale decision replay.
Theme, scaling, accessibility and keyboard input work on both named baselines without HEAD-only dependencies.
Notifications preserve privacy/DND and contain navigation-only actions.
Menu/desktop/shortcut installation preserves user customization and never silently changes default agent.
Native package activation is independently installed/qualified and cannot be bootstrapped by plugin code.
Paired-version upgrades and rollback preserve native operation/evidence state.
Removal respects exact file ownership and distinguishes client removal from native task termination.
Guest exclusion of operator/desktop sockets and truthful receipt provenance are independently demonstrated.
The controller MUST delegate authority, dispatch and recovery decisions to selected native owners.
Task creation MUST be durably reserved and reconciled by original identity across every preparation cutpoint.
A guest MUST start only after actual resource, authority and confinement readiness.
Client or QML failure MUST NOT change task authority or clear uncertainty.
One state-root owner and per-task serialization MUST prevent duplicate launches and conflicting control.
Backend incompatibility MUST refuse mutations and label any diagnostic projection.
Terminal task classification MUST join the actual native and resource outcome contracts.
New adapters MUST provide independent qualification of every consequential host surface.
Peers and socket paths MUST be validated, and operator transport MUST be absent from the guest.
Wire limits and closed schemas MUST be enforced before dispatch.
ABI negotiation MUST precede every connection's requests.
Idempotency lookup MUST preserve original mutations, including above capacity and after revision changes.
Mutations MUST bind exact semantic params and enforce revision comparison on new requests.
Snapshot and event cursors MUST prevent missing or duplicating projection changes across reconnect.
Slow consumers MUST cause bounded disconnect and resnapshot rather than unbounded buffering or silent loss.
Error responses MUST distinguish pre-dispatch failure from uncertain original outcomes.
Client bridge invocation MUST use literal argv/stdin and keep secrets out of process metadata.
Export MUST use an enrolled disclosure profile and retained effect identity.
Task creation MUST atomically bind the exact scope revision and digest reviewed by the operator.
Reconnected projections MUST expose independent admission, guest, provider-abort and reconciliation stop dimensions.
The declared trust profile MUST match actual principal and same-UID boundaries.
Authority MUST be provisioned by the selected native owner and bound to the exact task/resource/profile.
All consequential guest paths MUST be mediated or independently confined.
A proposal MUST bind the exact original operation, arguments, resource generation, policy, limits and validity.
Native decision validation MUST precede retention, rejecting a decision different from the operator's choice.
Approval consumption MUST be one-time and recover by original operation under concurrent/replayed requests.
Stale, expired, revoked or cancelled proposals MUST refuse without authority widening.
Reviewer presentation MUST separate verified bindings from untrusted content and disclose truncation.
Stop controls MUST report admission, process and effect outcomes independently.
Execution-only and required disclosure governance MUST remain explicitly distinguishable.
The first adapter MUST use the exact qualified Pi SDK/print entry mode and negotiate a closed installation descriptor before creating a task host; interactive or unsupported hosts MUST refuse.

The adapter MUST disable implicit discovery and freeze one exact tool registry, including aliases, schemas and canonical argument binding; reload and replacement sessions MUST retain these restrictions.
Preparation MUST pin all host/native/runtime/account/registry identities and validate required prerequisites before credential access or provider traffic; mismatch MUST refuse without fallback.
Protected effects MUST dispatch through their native owner and admission path; the guest MUST lack direct access to operator control, protected resources and alternative tool transports.
Provider and native credentials MUST remain in the trusted owner; guests receive only scoped transport access, and task input/credentials MUST use private non-argv transport.
Governance mode MUST be immutable and explicitly visible as `execution-only` or `required`; unavailable native committed model release MUST refuse `required` before credentials or egress.

Every model release MUST bind the exact selected provider route/model/account, permitted prompt/context, tool schemas and history; remote references, hosted tools and undeclared disclosure paths MUST refuse.

Limits MUST report enforceable, observed and unavailable dimensions separately; durable reservations/deadlines MUST survive failure/resume and no unsupported hard token or spending ceiling may be claimed.
Tool calls MUST execute sequentially, and a new effect MUST remain fenced while an earlier original lacks native delivery acknowledgement or retains uncertainty.
Completed-result ACK MUST require verified exact native history delivery and original receipt/result/authority binding; UI display, export, a denial or a tool callback alone MUST NOT ACK.
Native approval submission, decision and resume MUST remain separate operations; the known unavailable decision utility MUST refuse, and no desktop control may manufacture approval authority.
Lifecycle replacement, import, compaction, model changes and shutdown MUST preserve the frozen security binding and durable owner custody; unsupported transformations MUST refuse.

Cancellation and termination MUST report native admission/effect state independently from guest exit, preserve unresolved originals and observe actual process-group exit before releasing launch custody.
Errors MUST carry an exact safe binding and dispatch/evidence classification; unknown or mismatched outcomes MUST never become successful task completion or automatic retries.
Recovery MUST act on original native identities, current valid authority and independently verified retained results, with explicit refusal for missing/corrupt/foreign state and stale ownership.
Additional provider/host support MUST be gated by exact profile-specific acceptance, including negative boundaries, package provenance and current native compatibility.

Execution SHALL require a named x86_64 Omarchy support tuple and positive effective-feature probes; unsupported hosts retain read-only diagnostics and refuse mutation without a privileged or unconfined fallback.
Guest, recipe and native-resource enforcement SHALL have distinct manifest/profile identities and independent qualification; controller and trusted shell are outside the guest security boundary.
Admission SHALL bind the entire immutable runtime/mount closure and retain its identity through launch; additions, replacements, aliases, unresolved dependencies or executable mismatch refuse launch.
Guest admission SHALL prove unprivileged user, mount, PID, IPC, network and UTS namespaces, private process/device views, no new privileges and dropped capabilities under the actual service.
Each executable profile SHALL use its independently qualified architecture-specific seccomp policy and required Landlock rights; missing or partial mandatory enforcement refuses launch.
Guest communication SHALL be restricted to exact authenticated Chio/model routes, with operator, compositor, session, SSH, container, portal and other ambient sockets absent and unreachable.
Environment, argument vectors and inherited descriptors SHALL be constructed from explicit public allowlists; provider/operator credentials remain outside guest-visible files and process attributes.

Parent publication into or from guest-controlled storage SHALL use race-resistant retained-directory operations, exclusive temporary files and durable atomic commit, with no symlink/hardlink traversal or unverified destination replacement.
Every guest and recipe SHALL have effective task-scoped memory, process/thread, CPU, time, output and writable-storage bounds; admission refuses unavailable mandatory controls.
Stop, timeout, parent crash and service failure SHALL terminate the whole owned process tree and verify absence without relying on a signalled PID or wrapper exit alone.

Local lifetime accounting SHALL include suspend, bind to boot identity and preserve original cumulative reservations; restart, wall-clock rollback or checkpoint restore cannot renew authority or budget.
Suspend/resume SHALL stop new admission, bound local shutdown and require authority/operation reconciliation before any resumed work; uncertainty remains visible and fenced.
Lock, unlock, logout and shutdown SHALL follow the explicit session policy below, including missed events, lingering user managers and multiple graphical sessions.
Credential or route renewal SHALL occur only in the trusted native/relay path, bind the original task authority and invalidate stale transports without widening the guest profile.
ENOSPC, inode exhaustion, EIO, read-only filesystems, torn persistence and unexpected unmount SHALL fail closed while retaining operation identity and recovery evidence.
Project material and recipe effects SHALL cross through protected source-generation/test/publication adapters; a confined test success alone cannot authorize publication.
Health/status SHALL distinguish configured intent, observed enforcement, native evidence and qualification; host diagnostics and UI events are never substituted for execution receipts.
A release SHALL include independent positive and negative actual-Omarchy evidence for the complete selected tuple, including externally observed effects and lifecycle cleanup.
Only an operator-selected registered project and explicit import selection may enter a task; task text cannot choose host paths or discover repositories.
Intake MUST preserve dirty originals and retain reviewed provenance for tracked, staged, unstaged and selected untracked inputs.
Intake MUST inventory links, gitlinks, ignored and sensitive paths without following or silently admitting them; unsupported selections refuse.
The importer MUST publish one race-checked immutable selected generation or refuse; mixed-time copies are not an accepted snapshot.
The resource owner MUST be reachable only through the kernel-owned participant connection; guest host filesystem, operator state and original checkout access are absent.
The tool inventory MUST stay closed and bounded to the nine candidate tools; no shell, Git, network, arbitrary path or arbitrary recipe tool is added.
Patches MUST bind the current source digest and every full-file precondition and commit all changed resource files together.
Native original-operation binding, durable intent, generation publication and retained result MUST preserve uncertainty and exact replay across crashes.
Tests MUST execute only operator-pinned recipes against the exact immutable generation under qualified OS confinement and bounded lifetime/output.
Test success MUST retain exact source, recipe, runtime, result and operation lineage; command exit alone is insufficient to authorize a review artifact.
Publication MUST bind exact retained successful test lineage and destination; the only supported destination is the private local `review` artifact store.
Every returned context/output MUST carry source and sensitivity provenance, enforce serialized byte bounds and preserve explicit partial or truncated results.
Review MUST distinguish resource changes from original dirty changes and require an exact native approval wherever the task's publication policy requires one.
Cancellation, expiry and revocation MUST stop future admission and reconcile in-flight effects using their original identities before reporting completion.
Export, retention and recovery MUST preserve authoritative native evidence separately from unsigned resource bundles and never invent supported destinations.
P4 MUST advertise exactly the enabled closed desktop inventory and refuse every unqualified action before dispatch.
The protected desktop resource MUST own all compositor access and keep raw session/operator transports unreachable from the guest.
Each request MUST bind one enrolled user/session/compositor epoch and refuse stale, locked or ambiguous session targets.
Input schemas MUST reject extra properties, raw selectors, commands, arbitrary paths and unknown enum values before native admission.
Desktop reads MUST expose only the selected metadata with explicit freshness, bounded pages and privacy labels.
Workspace selection MUST target an explicit enrolled numeric slot, bind exact native approval and preserve its original operation identity.
Address-targeted window mutations MUST remain disabled until compositor-side stable-target validation closes address-reuse races.
A mutation result MUST distinguish dispatch, observed post-state and independently verified native execution evidence.
Bounded socket lifecycle, serialization and event resynchronization MUST protect compositor responsiveness and stale-state handling.
Cancellation, expiry, revocation and stop MUST be enforced by native admission and the resource, with honest in-flight outcomes.
Lost responses and resource/controller restarts MUST reconcile the original operation without redispatching or treating current desktop state as original completion.
Screenshots, screen recording, clipboard and OCR MUST remain unavailable in the default profile pending explicit disclosure and target/capture gates.
Launch, URL opening, keystrokes, notifications with actions, audio/network/power and package operations MUST remain outside this first desktop profile.
Desktop observations and untrusted strings MUST not become instructions, executable markup, approval authority or unbounded logs.
Each enabled profile MUST retain source provenance, exact tool/schema/policy hashes and actual-machine independent acceptance evidence.
The first repair profile MUST restrict changes to the declared single-file scalar domain and reject broad or privileged repair requests.
Diagnosis MUST retain bounded selected evidence with source/version/time provenance and distinguish observations from causal hypotheses.
Proposed bytes MUST be generated and reviewed from one immutable config snapshot with exact before/after hashes and a closed semantic diff.
Preflight MUST parse and validate only private copied inputs under confinement; proposed or existing Lua must never execute on the host merely to validate.
Apply MUST require native approval binding the exact file set, patch, validation, backup, reload effect plan, session/version and expiry.
Independent home-configuration backups MUST be durably verified before mutation; system snapshots are not accepted as those backups.
File mutation MUST use a qualified writer-exclusion and compare-and-swap protocol with no-follow identity checks; ordinary hash-then-rename is insufficient.
Original intent, individual file stages, reload boundary and terminal outcome MUST be durable; multi-file requests are refused in the first profile and never described as atomic without proof.
Reload MUST be explicitly included in the effect plan, bounded to the enrolled session and refused when dependent Lua/hooks have unbounded or changed effects.
Success MUST require exact installed bytes, empty relevant config errors and independently observed live scalar values; a successful command alone is insufficient.
Rollback MUST compare the current state, preserve newer user changes and retain the original failure; failed or uncertain rollback cannot be called restored.
Crash, lost reply, cancellation and timeout MUST reconcile the original operation and preserve unknown effects instead of automatically retrying apply or reload.
Config, logs, backups and diagnostic outputs MUST remain private, bounded and excluded from provider/export channels unless explicitly selected.
The default repair profile MUST have no sudo/polkit, package/update, bootloader, system snapshot, service-management or arbitrary command authority.
P5 enablement MUST require an actual-machine fault matrix, independent restoration evidence and a version-bound profile gate.
QML distribution SHALL remain separate from backend/runtime package installation, with explicit missing-dependency UX and no privileged or remote-code installation side effect.

Every supported release SHALL publish an exact support tuple and named qualified profiles, separating source support, installation, Linux enforcement, native recovery, provider and desktop acceptance.
Backend/runtime artifacts SHALL be reproducibly built from public immutable inputs in recorded clean build environments, with dependency inventories, licenses and machine-readable SBOM/provenance.
Installation and activation SHALL require authenticated package/artifact integrity and declared publisher trust, rejecting invalid, untrusted, revoked or manifest-mismatched inputs.

Runtime selection SHALL use package-owned absolute paths and exact manifests; host, mise or dependency drift invalidates affected execution qualification without silently changing runtime or weakening controls.
Services SHALL run as the desktop user with explicit opt-in activation, bounded restart/stop policy, session ownership and no automatic lingering or global system mutation.
Each controller/launcher/relay/guest unit SHALL have a tested role-specific hardening matrix, effective-limit observations and explicit refusal for unavailable required protections.

Updates SHALL use a durable staged activation transaction that quiesces effects, validates exact runtime/state compatibility and atomically commits one generation without concurrent mixed-generation task execution.

Rollback SHALL preserve monotonic authority/effect custody and enforce read/write state ABI compatibility; incompatible rollback is diagnostic-only and cannot restore an old state snapshot over uncertain effects.
Plugin/controller protocol mismatch SHALL produce a bounded compatibility result; independent plugin reload/update never launches a second controller, repeats a mutation or claims task completion.
Local health and monitoring SHALL expose actionable bounded diagnostics with separate connectivity, compatibility, enforcement, storage and native-authority dimensions.
Logs, telemetry and diagnostic exports SHALL follow explicit data minimization, size/rate/retention bounds and local review; none is authoritative execution evidence.
Backups SHALL capture a consistent declared state set with manifests, required trust material and recovery dependencies, while excluding transient sockets and unnecessary credentials.

Restore SHALL quarantine incompatible/corrupt state and reconcile original native operations and rollback anchors before effects, without creating replacement task/operation identities to bypass uncertainty.
Disable/uninstall SHALL stop admission and owned processes, preserve unresolved operations and user data by default, and require a separate explicit destructive purge action.
Package, activation and runtime storage failures SHALL leave an independently diagnosable fail-closed state with retained previous-generation and recovery metadata.
Security and compatibility updates SHALL have a documented signed channel, bounded qualification ownership and revocation response without unattended authority expansion or implicit task replay.
Release approval SHALL require an independent clean consumer install/upgrade/rollback/backup/restore/uninstall run on the exact x86_64 Omarchy tuple, including negative cases and named scope.
Delegation MUST remain unavailable until P3 and exact native process/child/confinement prerequisites pass; Pi callback or package availability alone MUST NOT enable it.
Every child MUST descend from one retained parent under the selected authority through verified signed attenuation; issuer, scope, validity, budget family and target bindings MUST remain constrained.

Child admission MUST atomically retain original request identity, exact template/input binding, capability and signer custody before launch; duplicate requests MUST replay original admission or conflict.
Workers MUST use operator-installed immutable templates and independently qualified guest confinement; child input MUST NOT choose executable, argv, environment, packages, sockets or authority.

Root and subtree limits MUST cover admitted processes, depth, concurrency, logical calls, provider usage and wall/expiry bounds; sibling reservations MUST fit their parent without implicit reclamation.
Expiry, revocation and cancellation MUST fence new admission at the native linearization point; previously admitted effects and surviving processes MUST retain truthful independent status.
Every logical effect MUST retain its original native identity, exact request/authority binding and admission history across worker crash, host change and result delivery.
Each active worker and authoritative state writer MUST have one verifiable owner with fenced generation/lease; timeout or stale PID alone MUST NOT authorize takeover or effect repetition.

Cross-host communication MUST authenticate host/worker/authority and restrict routes, disclose only admitted context and retain exact dependency/artifact identities; raw host-control sockets MUST remain inaccessible.
Handoff or relocation MUST transfer complete required custody and original records through a native-supported protocol; the source MUST be retired/fenced before destination authority can serve.
Unknown remote effects MUST remain unresolved until native/provider-owned original evidence permits reconciliation; no arbitrary exactly-once external-effect guarantee or blind retry is permitted.
Child results MUST pass native receipt/result and disclosure verification before parent ingestion or ACK; a child success claim, message or checkpoint MUST NOT authorize another effect.
Parent wait/settle behavior MUST be bounded, acyclic and truthful about failures/cancelled/unknown descendants; required unresolved work MUST prevent root success.
P6 release qualification MUST separately identify local workers, remote workers and relocation, with exact artifacts and independent race/failure evidence for every advertised profile.
Task projections MUST keep immutable native bindings and never manufacture receipt authority.
State transitions and profile completion predicates MUST distinguish process exit, test failure and unknown effect outcomes.
Restart MUST reconcile original IDs without automatically restarting guest work or widening limits.
Durable intent MUST precede dispatch, and native outbox replay MUST be idempotent.
Task, mutation and event updates MUST commit consistently under concurrent controls.
Retention MUST pin uncertainty and preserve replay tombstones or retire the whole enrollment epoch.
Storage exhaustion MUST stop new work while preserving bounded stop/recovery routes.
Restore, migration and rollback MUST reconcile forward and refuse incompatible schemas.
Evidence MUST preserve source/component/runtime/release distinctions and report skipped cases.
Runtime denial claims MUST have independent outside-effect oracles and positive controls.
Qualification MUST exercise deterministic dispatch/delivery/recovery crash cutpoints.
Every release profile MUST map to complete current-tuple requirement evidence.
Clean-install lifecycle and independent operator acceptance MUST precede profile publication claims.
The document validator MUST fail broken traceability, malformed examples and incompatible response shapes.
Phase execution MUST respect native prerequisites and selected-profile dependency edges.
Open prerequisite closure MUST include exact identity and independently observed acceptance.
Architecture changes MUST update contracts, applicability and plans together.
Failed experiments MUST preserve explicit unavailable profiles instead of weakening authority.
Disclosures MUST follow the inventory and distinguish source read from provider release.
Sensitive data MUST be excluded from notifications, process metadata and default diagnostics.
Lock or unknown session ownership MUST redact views and invalidate review handles.
Support export MUST preview and enforce an enrolled bounded disclosure profile.
Performance claims MUST include reproducible machine, workload and percentile evidence.
Unknown outcomes and surviving descendants MUST remain actionable until native reconciliation.
